literal_meaning: মৃদু কম্পনের শব্দ (onomatopoeic representation of slight trembling)
figurative_meaning_en: A mild trembling sound caused by fear
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভয়ে তার বুকের মধ্যে দুড়দুড় করছে।
অন্ধকার দেখে শরীরে দুড়দুড় অনুভূত হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Fear made his heart thud inside his chest.
Darkness caused a shiver to run through his body.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to describe internal fear sensations.
